lines.beaver_en: Come in. What brings you here today?
lines.en: Last night I ate a poisonous mushroom and went to the ER.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, you must have been scared. How did you get there?
lines.learner: 너무 아파서 생각다 못해 구급차를 불렀어요.
lines.en: It hurt so much that I had no choice but to call an ambulance.
lines.roman: neomu apaseo saenggakda motae gugeupchareul bulleosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What treatment did you get in the ER?
lines.en: I got an antidote to get the poison out of my body.

lines.beaver_en: Did you take any medicine at home before that?
lines.en: I had a fever, so I took a fever reducer from my emergency kit.
I was a bit dizzy, but I'm not sure if it was a side effect.
Yes, I was diagnosed with food poisoning.
I've recovered a lot, but I'm still a little dizzy.

lines.beaver_en: Are you taking any other medicine?
lines.learner: 회복에 좋다고 해서 한약을 먹고 있어요.
lines.en: I'm taking herbal medicine because it's said to help recovery.
lines.roman: hoeboge jotago haeseo hanyageul meokgo isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 당분간 한약은 쉬시고 이 약을 드세요.
lines.beaver_en: Stop the herbal medicine for now and take this instead.
lines.beaver_roman: dangbungan hanyageun swisigo i yageul deuseyo.
lines.learner: 이 약은 약효가 좋아요? 완치될 수 있을까요?
lines.en: Does this medicine work well? Can I be fully cured?
lines.roman: i yageun yakyoga joayo? wanchidoel su isseulkkayo?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, if you take it for about a week, you'll be fully cured.
lines.en: What a relief. Thank you, doctor.
